description: Distribution Network Options Assessments is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. The " Distribution Network Options Assessments (DNOA) " data table provides stakeholders with more information on individual scheme decisions. This provides an overview of the individual constraint, how we are managing it, where flexibility forms part of our solution, and details of the flexibility requirements at this location. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Future Networks, Flexibility. Its keywords are SPM, SPD, Constraint, Reinforcement, DNOA, Distribution Network Options Assessments. The portal shows 2025-10-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
